fato_historico: 1999: Russian president Boris Yeltsin fires his prime minister, Sergei Stepashin, and for the fourth time fires his entire cabinet.
energia_do_dia: Today may bring a sudden shift in your professional landscape, much like a grand reshuffling of pieces on a vast chessboard. It is a good time to view unexpected changes as invitations to reset your path. Consider how fresh starts can clear the way for your brightest adventures and allow your optimistic spirit to flourish anew.
frase_do_dia: Every ending is merely a new beginning waiting to be explored with joy.
significado_numero: The number of harmony and nurturing new creative opportunities.
conselho: Stay flexible and keep your heart open to the surprising twists of fate.
